title: Selection mode cross-page state stored in `localStorage` — unencrypted; two tabs corrupt each other's selection; bypasses Next.js router state in `EvidenceManagementContent.jsx`
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/EvidenceManagementContent.jsx:200`
**Root Cause (original):** `selectedEvidenceIds` was stored in `localStorage`, shared across all browser tabs on the same origin, so two tabs open to the evidence list overwrote each other's selection.
**Status:** FIXED — re-verified 2026-08-30. `handleConfirmSelection` now calls `sessionStorage.setItem('selectedEvidenceIds', ...)` (line 200), with an inline comment explicitly citing EM-035. A repo-wide grep for `localStorage` in this file returns zero matches. This matches the fix prompt's alternative recommendation (sessionStorage, tab-scoped) rather than pure React state, since the value must survive a same-tab navigation — a reasonable choice, not a deviation. No regression found.

title: Version picker loads max 100 items with no title search — `EvidenceVersionsContent.jsx` picker uses `limit: 100`; projects with >100 items require raw MongoDB ObjectId or EV-xxx format; no title-based search
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/integration-hub/EvidenceVersionsContent.jsx:55-78`; `vibrantix-backend/src/modules/evidence/evidence.controller.js` (`getEvidenceByProjectId`)
**Root Cause (original):** The version picker fetched a flat `limit: 100` page with no text search — projects with >100 items required the exact ObjectId/EV-xxx code.
**Status:** FIXED — re-verified 2026-08-30. The picker now has a real `evidenceSearch` state, debounced (300ms) re-fetch that sends `search` to `getEvidenceByProject` (lines 55-78, explicitly citing EM-036), and `limit` reduced to 50. The backend's `GET /evidence/project/:projectId` (`getEvidenceByProjectId`) already implements real server-side full-text `search` filtering on `title`/`description`/`evidenceCode` — confirmed genuinely functional end-to-end, not a client-side-only filter. No date-range picker was added (a residual gap vs. the full fix prompt), but the core defect — no way to find an item without its exact code — is closed. No regression found.
fixEvidence: `EvidenceVersionsContent.jsx:55-78` (debounced server-side search) + `vibrantix-backend/src/modules/evidence/evidence.controller.js:653-661` (real `search` filter on title/description/evidenceCode) — confirmed working end-to-end on 2026-08-30 (client-panel HEAD d400be5a, backend HEAD 8641818, both `feature/dev`).

title: Scan ID provider extraction fragile — `firstScanId.split('-').pop()` in `AutoCollectorsContent.jsx` returns last segment; format change returns incorrect provider; silent wrong identification
fixEvidence: Re-verified 2026-08-27: `AutoCollectorsContent.jsx:41-45` now defines `extractProviderFromScanId(scanId)`, which finds the segment matching a `SCAN_PROVIDERS` allowlist (`scanId.split('_').find((part) => SCAN_PROVIDERS.includes(part))`) instead of naively taking the last hyphen-delimited segment — exactly the validated-allowlist approach the original fix prompt recommended. Used at line 147 (`const provider = extractProviderFromScanId(firstScanId)`). No `.split('-').pop()` pattern remains anywhere in the file.
description:
**Files (original):** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/AutoCollectorsContent.jsx`
**Root Cause (original):** Provider was extracted via `firstScanId.split('-').pop()`, fragile to format changes.
**Status:** FIXED — see fixEvidence.

title: Hard navigation via `window.location.href` after AI upload — `AIUploadInterface.jsx` destroys React state, bypasses Next.js router, no unsaved-state warning
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/evidence-management/AIUploadInterface.jsx:289,293`
**Root Cause (original):** Post-upload navigation used `window.location.href`, a full browser reload that destroys React state and bypasses the Next.js router.
**Status:** FIXED — re-verified 2026-08-30. `AIUploadInterface.jsx` now imports `useRouter` from `next/navigation` (line 21), and `handleUpload` calls `router.push(\`/ai-evidence/${created[0]._id}/review\`)` (line 293) instead of `window.location.href`, with a code comment explicitly citing EM-038. No remaining `window.location.href` navigation found in the file. No regression found.
fixEvidence: `AIUploadInterface.jsx:21,96,289,293` — `useRouter`/`router.push` now used for post-upload navigation, `window.location.href` removed, confirmed on 2026-08-30 (client-panel HEAD d400be5a, `feature/dev`).
